source.scope: All seven existing records and four captions. ZL raw groups reproduced with separators; IT/RF remain in unchanged source packet and are not merged into ZL. No new acquisition.

main_point: Using a learned preparation specification is not the same as re-executing its preparation. A shared-curriculum reading of this whole page can concern four applications under one grammar without asserting four new batches or four repetitions of every learned step.

finite_common_grammar.source_level: PAGE = CASE(E1,P1) CASE(E2,P2) CASE(E3,P3) CASE(E4,CONCAT(P4,P5),SUB(Q1),SUB(Q2)) plus four separately retained caption expressions. This is a proposed discourse skeleton, not a recovered token grammar.
finite_common_grammar.library_budget: One shared opaque procedure specification Pi for the candidate, not a separately invented library entry for every native whole or paragraph. The actual ordered content of Pi is UNASSIGNED and therefore supplies no translated action. Its complete eventual definition must be charged as learned information.
finite_common_grammar.two_interpretations: APPLICATION uses Pi as the specification governing a requested or described use under E_i and explicitly written parameters; NAMED_PREPARATION merely refers to the prepared type characterized by Pi and lets separately written local predicates govern its use. Neither interpretation implies fresh preparation, repeated batch identity, a patient or an observed success.
finite_common_grammar.composition: Concatenated physical records preserve all their expressions in order but do not automatically create extra procedure executions. Subordinate records retain the same E4, without automatic attachment to either pictured instance. Captions may be nominal, relational or predicative; their roles remain unknown.
finite_common_grammar.evaluation: Without a native parse and parameter bindings return an unresolved semantic expression, never VOID, zero events, success or a fluent completed sentence. No library expansion is fabricated from image resemblance.

worked_conditional_branch.surface: The preserved f83r.7 ends with qokedy qoteedy qoteedy in the existing ZL packet. The two exact qoteedy occurrences must stay distinct written occurrences.
worked_conditional_branch.status: Unassigned role alternatives, not adopted lexical premises or translated coverage.
worked_conditional_branch.call_branch: IF a future profile/prior-supported parse makes each qoteedy occurrence a procedure invocation with its required arguments, the two occurrences denote two distinct invocation positions. Execution requires a licensed execution mode and defined body; the doublet alone does not establish either.
worked_conditional_branch.type_reference_branch: IF instead qoteedy denotes a procedure/preparation type, both occurrences can mention that same type in two constructions. Repeated mention need not execute or manufacture anything twice.
worked_conditional_branch.actual_difference: The call reading owes two invocation bindings; the type reading owes two syntactic roles for the mentions. An actual physical history, event count, equal arguments, timing, quantity or same batch is not inferred in either branch.
